commitResults.messageTitle: Add MishMash logging and organize code by responsibility
commitResults.messageBody:
Record application lifecycle, command execution and cancellation, and parser
diagnostics with Java's built-in logging. Rotate log files and release handlers
on shutdown so diagnostics stay separate from normal console interaction.

Replace the placeholder seedu.duke namespace with seedu.mishmash packages for
commands, parsing, models, generation, display, and exceptions. Move tests to
matching packages and share fixtures through test utilities while preserving
the integrated recipe listing, deletion, and meal-plan generation behavior.

Update the application entry point and produce MishMash.jar. Refresh setup
instructions and documentation branding, and include the existing User Guide
draft-note cleanup. Leave the Developer Guide unchanged.

Validated with Java 25: 558 tests passed, Checkstyle passed, and the packaged
application passed command and logging checks. Rebuilt the Shadow JAR with its
official filename.
Create grocery command parsing and integration
Add personal info for neil
Implement add-recipe with input validation and JUnit tests

Users can remove a recipe by its 1-based index. The CLI names the recipe and asks y/n first, since later indices shift after a delete. Errors for a missing index are reported before asking. Parser now dispatches on the command word and attaches that command's usage to its errors, replacing the add-recipe usage that was always printed.
